project_type: React 19 + Vite frontend, React Router DOM for routing, Zustand for state, Three.js + @react-three/fiber + @react-three/drei for 3D preview
test_framework: None currently configured. No test command in package.json.
test_command: No automated tests. Manual verification via npm run dev + browser testing required.
verification_instructions: Run npm run dev, open http://localhost:5173, navigate to /dieline (gallery), click a template card to open configuration screen, change dimensions to verify 2D/3D update, click 'Open in Editor', verify editor receives configuration state, change dimensions in editor, verify 2D canvas and 3D preview update. Search/filter/sort must work in gallery. No console errors. npm run build must succeed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. All source is committed as-is.
environment_constraints: Frontend only. No backend. Mock data in src/data/dielineTemplates.js. Dev server runs on :5173. Do NOT restart the dev server unless instructed. Use React 19 and Vite 8 APIs.
contribution_requirements: No formal CONTRIBUTING.md. Per README: use React 19, Vite, JavaScript, React Router DOM, plain CSS, lucide-react icons only, no Tailwind/Bootstrap/Material UI. Keep architecture ready for Three.js/Express/PostgreSQL integration later. Create service abstraction layer for data so backend APIs can replace mock data without rewriting pages.
key_patterns: Routing: react-router-dom with <Routes>/<Route> in App.jsx. State: Zustand store in src/store/useEditorStore.js (not currently used by dieline pages). Icons: lucide-react. Styling: CSS modules or plain CSS in src/styles/. Canvas 2D rendering: DielineCanvas.jsx uses useRef + canvas API. 3D: Dieline3DPreview.jsx uses @react-three/fiber <Canvas> with <OrbitControls> from @react-three/drei. Geometry: dielineGeometry.js exports generateDielineLayout (returns {panels, foldLines, cutLines, totalWidth, totalHeight}). Templates: dielineTemplates.js exports array of {id, code, title, category, description, styleId, dimensions, previewTone, illustrative?}.
relevant_files: src/pages/DielineTemplatesPage.jsx (gallery, currently renders DielineStudio inline when ?template= is set — must be changed to navigate to /dieline/configure instead)
src/pages/DielineStudio.jsx (editor, needs to become /dieline/editor route and accept location.state for template config)
src/components/dieline/DielineCanvas.jsx (2D canvas, fold lines render as grey dashed lines — must be changed to blue #2563eb)
src/components/dieline/Dieline3DPreview.jsx (3D box, all sides render as flat panels stacked — geometry maps to 3D positions correctly but camera/scale needs verification)

src/utils/dielineGeometry.js (geometry engine — currently lays all panels vertically stacked, fold lines only horizontal, cut lines just bounding rect — needs horizontal net layout for shipping-box/RSC)
directory_structure: src/App.jsx (routes), src/pages/ (page components), src/components/dieline/ (canvas, 3D preview, properties, toolbar, template preview), src/utils/ (geometry logic), src/data/ (mock data), src/styles/ (CSS), src/store/ (Zustand store — not used by dieline yet)
